llm.summary: The instructions generally match a remote-agent TradingView indicators workflow, but the skill references API credentials (PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY and PRANA_SKILL_SECRET_KEY) and sensitive purchase URLs without declaring or justifying required environment variables—an incoherence that could enable credential misuse or data exposure.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description (remote execution of TradingView indicator analysis via prana.chat) align with the two network endpoints in SKILL.md (agent-run and skill-purchase-history-url). However, the SKILL.md states that PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY and PRANA_SKILL_SECRET_KEY must be made available for the purchase-history endpoint, yet the skill metadata declares no required environment variables or credentials. That mismatch is unexpected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent to POST user messages to https://prana.chat/api/claw/agent-run and to GET /api/claw/skill-purchase-history-url (and to poll agent-result with request_id). The instructions do not ask the agent to read local files or unrelated system state, which is good, but they do reference and require API keys (PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY/SECRET) that are not declared in the skill manifest. The guidance to send the full purchase-history link to the user (link may include a pay_token) raises privacy concerns if not handled explicitly.

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. Nothing is written to disk by the skill package itself (lowest install risk).

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md requires PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY and PRANA_SKILL_SECRET_KEY for the purchase-history flow, but the skill metadata lists no required env vars or primary credential. This is a clear mismatch: sensitive credentials are implied but not declared or scoped. The skill otherwise does not request unrelated credentials, but the missing declaration is problematic for user consent and review.

dimensions.detail: always:false and no install behavior; the skill does not request permanent presence or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other privilege escalations in this package.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to call prana.chat endpoints to run analyses, but the SKILL.md says you must make PRANA_SKILL_PUBLIC_KEY and PRANA_SKILL_SECRET_KEY available while the registry metadata lists no required environment variables—ask the publisher to explicitly declare required env vars and explain authentication. Before installing, verify prana.chat is a trusted endpoint for your data, do not paste secrets or private API keys into the 'question' or message text, and be cautious about the purchase-history link (it may include a pay_token or other sensitive query parameter). If you plan to use it, require the publisher to (1) document exactly which env vars are required and how they're used, (2) provide a privacy/data-flow statement showing what user data is sent to prana.chat, and (3) identify the publisher/source (homepage or verified owner) so you can validate trustworthiness. If those clarifications are not provided, avoid installing or supplying credentials.
